__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: Pick the Prometheus that scrapes vlpds /metrics

title: vlpds internals
description: vlpds internals, for engineers debugging the PDS cluster: health first, then one collapsed row per subsystem. The operator's view is the 'vlpds' dashboard. Generated by bench/obs/grafana/gen_dashboard.py (also printed by `vlpds dashboards`).

links.title: Operator dashboard
links.tooltip: The PDS operator's view: users, content, federation, cost

list.name: Paging alerts
list.expr: max by (alertname, severity) (ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname=~"Vlpds.*", severity="page", cluster=~"$cluster"})

panels.title: Requests/s
panels.description: Every request a node answered (XRPC, proxied, OAuth, ...), summed over the selected nodes.

panels.title: 5xx
panels.description: Share of requests answered 5xx, proxied/unmatched paths excluded (the AppView's errors aren't ours). Red at 5%: the page threshold of [VlpdsHttp5xxHigh](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdshttp5xxhigh) (5 min sustained). Yellow at 1% (guess). Break it down in HTTP & proxy.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(vlpds_http_requests_total{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", method!="_proxy_or_unmatched", status=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / sum(rate(vlpds_http_requests_total{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", method!="_proxy_or_unmatched"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.description: Share of requests refused with 429: rate limits, the proxy's per-account cap, the firehose per-IP cap. No alert: yellow 1% / red 10% are guesses. Who is limited: Auth & abuse row.

panels.title: Read p99
panels.description: p99 of repo/sync/identity reads served by vlpds itself (getRecord, listRecords, sync.get*, ...). No alert: 250 ms / 1 s are guesses. Proxied AppView reads are in HTTP & proxy.

panels.title: Write p99
panels.description: p99 of createRecord / putRecord / deleteRecord / applyWrites, forwarding to the shard owner included. Same thresholds as commit p99 (writes wait for their commit).

panels.title: Commit p99
panels.description: Commit enqueue to durable + applied + acked. Design: ~150 ms on S3 Standard. Yellow 500 ms = [VlpdsCommitLatencyHigh](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdscommitlatencyhigh), red 2 s = [VlpdsCommitLatencyCritical](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdscommitlatencycritical) (page; the 3 s forward deadline is close).

panels.title: Firehose lag p99
panels.description: Seq assignment to firehose emit (the merger waits for every log's watermark). Yellow 2 s = [VlpdsFirehoseEmitDelayHigh](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsfirehoseemitdelayhigh), red 20 s = [VlpdsFirehoseEmitDelayCritical](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsfirehoseemitdelaycritical) (page).

panels.title: Firehose subscribers
panels.description: Connected subscribeRepos clients. A sudden drop to 0 with relays expected = they were cut off: see Firehose → disconnects by reason.

panels.title: Nodes up
panels.description: Scraped nodes up / down. Down counts only targets that exported vlpds_build_info in the last hour, so idle bench ports don't count. Any down for 2 min pages: [VlpdsNodeDown](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsnodedown).

targets.expr: count((up{job=~"$job", cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"} == 0) and on (instance) group by (instance) (last_over_time(vlpds_build_info{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"}[1h]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Shards
panels.description: Whole cluster (ignores the node filter). unowned = layout shards - owned: any for 2 min pages ([VlpdsShardsUnowned](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsshardsunowned): their writes and reads fail); negative (yellow) = two owners claim a shard ([VlpdsShardsOverOwned](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsshardsoverowned)).

panels.title: Lease renew/TTL
panels.description: Worst node's p99 lease renewal round trip as a share of its TTL. Past 0.4 x TTL the node's validity gaps and it fail-stops (exit 5). Yellow 0.2 = [VlpdsLeaseRenewalNearCeiling](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsleaserenewalnearceiling), red 0.4 = [VlpdsLeaseRenewalAtCeiling](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsleaserenewalatceiling) (page; several nodes at once = a store brownout).

panels.title: Store errors/s
panels.description: vlpds' object-store requests that failed or timed out (all clients: log, state, control plane). Red at 1/s on one component = [VlpdsObjectStoreErrors](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsobjectstoreerrors) (state_*: SlateDB) or [VlpdsObjectStoreRequestErrors](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsobjectstorerequesterrors) (the rest); on 2+ nodes at once = [VlpdsObjectStoreBrownout](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsobjectstorebrownout). Per client and component: Object store row.

panels.title: Store permit waits/s
panels.description: Object-store requests that found every in-flight permit of their pool (log / state / ctl) and lane taken and queued. Red at 1/s = [VlpdsObjectStorePermitsSaturated](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsobjectstorepermitssaturated): the store got slower or the load outgrew the permits.

panels.title: Restarts (1 h)
panels.description: Process restarts over the last hour: all selected nodes, and the node that restarted most. Any = [VlpdsNodeRestarted](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsnoderestarted); 3 on one node = [VlpdsNodeCrashLooping](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsnodecrashlooping) (page). Why: the nodes table's last exit column.

panels.title: Fail-stops (30 m)
panels.description: Nodes that started in the last 30 min after a fail-stop, crash or error exit (vlpds_last_exit_reason_info, as [VlpdsNodeFailStopped](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsnodefailstopped)). The reason is in the nodes table; exit codes: [runbook exit codes](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#tools-endpoints-cli-logs-exit-codes).

targets.expr: count(vlpds_last_exit_reason_info{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", reason!~"clean|none"} == 1 and on (instance) (time() - vlpds_process_start_time_seconds{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"}) < 1800) or vector(0)

panels.title: Alerts firing
panels.description: Vlpds* alerts firing in this Prometheus, by severity. Which ones: the timeline below. Needs ops/alerts.yml loaded in the rule evaluator that writes ALERTS to this Prometheus; without it this stays empty ([monitoring docs](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/docs/operations/monitoring.md)). The bench stack doesn't load it.

targets.expr: count(ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname=~"Vlpds.*", severity="page", cluster=~"$cluster"}) or vector(0)
count(ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname=~"Vlpds.*", severity!="page", cluster=~"$cluster"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Alerts firing
panels.description: Vlpds* alerts from ops/alerts.yml (https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/alerts.yml); each one's runbook section is https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#<alertname>. Filtered by cluster only, not by node. Empty = nothing firing, or the rules aren't loaded. Needs ops/alerts.yml loaded in the rule evaluator that writes ALERTS to this Prometheus; without it this stays empty ([monitoring docs](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/docs/operations/monitoring.md)).

panels.title: Requests/s by status
panels.description: Stacked by class; 4xx excludes 429, which has its own series. Same colours on every panel.

panels.title: Error ratio
panels.description: 5xx share (proxied paths excluded) and 429 share. Dashed: the 5% page threshold of [VlpdsHttp5xxHigh](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdshttp5xxhigh).

targets.expr: clamp_max((sum(rate(vlpds_http_requests_total{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", method!="_proxy_or_unmatched", status=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / sum(rate(vlpds_http_requests_total{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", method!="_proxy_or_unmatched"}[$__rate_interval])), 1)

panels.title: p99: reads, writes, commit
panels.description: Dashed: the commit latency alerts (500 ms ticket, 2 s page). A write above its commit = forwarding or queueing in front of the commit.

panels.title: Owned shards by node
panels.description: Stacked per node; the dashed line is the layout's shard count, which the stack should reach exactly ([VlpdsShardsUnowned](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsshardsunowned), [VlpdsOwnershipImbalanced](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsownershipimbalanced)).

targets.expr: (sum by (instance) (vlpds_owned_partitions{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"})) * on (instance) group_left (node_id) max by (instance, node_id) (vlpds_build_info{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Lease renew / TTL p99 by node
panels.description: Renewal round trip as a share of the lease TTL. Over 0.4 the node fail-stops; dashed at the two lease alerts. [VlpdsLeaseRenewalNearCeiling](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsleaserenewalnearceiling)

targets.expr: (histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, instance) (rate(vlpds_lease_renew_ttl_ratio_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))) * on (instance) group_left (node_id) max by (instance, node_id) (vlpds_build_info{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Firehose lag p99 by node
panels.description: Seq assigned to emitted. One node high = its merger; all high = a slow log holds the min watermark. [VlpdsFirehoseEmitDelayHigh](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsfirehoseemitdelayhigh)

targets.expr: (histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, instance) (rate(vlpds_firehose_emit_delay_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))) * on (instance) group_left (node_id) max by (instance, node_id) (vlpds_build_info{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Object store: failures and permit waits
panels.description: Failed requests, permit queueing, control-plane steps that hit their deadline; per pool and lane in the Object store row ([VlpdsControlPlaneTimeouts](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdscontrolplanetimeouts)). On 2+ nodes at once: [VlpdsObjectStoreBrownout](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsobjectstorebrownout).

panels.title: CPU by node
panels.description: CPU cores used (user + system). Tokio saturation is in Process / runtime.

targets.expr: (sum by (instance) (rate(vlpds_process_cpu_seconds_total{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (instance) group_left (node_id) max by (instance, node_id) (vlpds_build_info{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Memory used / limit by node
panels.description: RSS / vlpds_memory_limit_bytes (RAM or the cgroup limit). Dashed: [VlpdsMemoryHigh](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsmemoryhigh) (85%) and [VlpdsMemoryCritical](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsmemorycritical) (95%, page).

targets.expr: (max by (instance) (vlpds_process_resident_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"}) / max by (instance) (vlpds_memory_limit_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"})) * on (instance) group_left (node_id) max by (instance, node_id) (vlpds_build_info{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: One row per node: id, git rev (-dirty = uncommitted changes; two revs for an hour = [VlpdsMixedVersions](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsmixedversions)), up, uptime, owned shards, and how its previous process ended (clean, crash = SIGKILL/OOM/host loss, or a fail-stop reason; see the runbook's exit codes).

targets.expr: max by (instance) (up{job=~"$job", cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"}) and on (instance) group by (instance) (last_over_time(vlpds_build_info{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"}[1h]))

panels.title: Write latency
panels.description: createRecord / putRecord / deleteRecord / applyWrites, server side, forwarding included. Buckets 0.1 ms .. 52 s, x2: quantiles are bucket-resolution estimates.

panels.title: Commit latency (enqueue → durable + applied + acked)
panels.description: Dashed: [VlpdsCommitLatencyHigh](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdscommitlatencyhigh) (p99 500 ms) and [VlpdsCommitLatencyCritical](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdscommitlatencycritical) (2 s, page). Where the time goes: the stage panels below.

panels.title: Coalescing
panels.description: Means over the rate window: write requests per commit, ops per commit, firehose events per segment, worker messages per loop. Higher = more batching (good under load).

panels.title: Rejected and retried writes
panels.description: internal/unavailable errors: [VlpdsWriteInternalErrors](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdswriteinternalerrors); shed = admission control ([VlpdsWritesShed](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdswritesshed)); resent = the entry node retried after a not-applied 503 ([VlpdsWriteResendsSustained](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdswriteresendssustained)). Client errors (invalid record, ...) are normal.

panels.title: Mean time per stage (per segment)
panels.description: seal_wait: oldest entry's enqueue → PUT start; put: PUT until durable (hedges/retries incl.); apply_lock: finalizer waiting for the shards' apply locks; apply: SlateDB batches; ack: acks + repo views. The stack approximates the commit latency of a segment's oldest entry.

panels.title: Stage p99
panels.description: Which stage owns the tail. put high: the store (Log / segments); apply high: SlateDB (L0 stalls, backpressure).

panels.title: Queues: sequencer, PUTs in flight, workers
panels.description: Entries waiting while no segment becomes durable for 2 min = [VlpdsCommitLogStalled](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdscommitlogstalled) (page).

panels.title: Watermark lag by node
panels.description: now - the node's log watermark. ~one segment PUT under load, ~0 idle. Dashed: [VlpdsWatermarkLagHigh](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdswatermarklaghigh) (2 s). A lagging log holds back every node's firehose.

targets.expr: (max by (instance) (vlpds_watermark_lag_microseconds{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"}) / 1e6) * on (instance) group_left (node_id) max by (instance, node_id) (vlpds_build_info{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"})

(sum by (instance) (rate(vlpds_segments_total{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (instance) group_left (node_id) max by (instance, node_id) (vlpds_build_info{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Segment PUT latency (until durable)
panels.description: Design ~25 ms; a hedge starts at 100 ms. Dashed: [VlpdsSegmentPutLatencyHigh](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdssegmentputlatencyhigh) (p99 250 ms).

panels.title: PUT attempts by result, hedges, stall seals
panels.description: already_exists = a conditional-PUT conflict (our own hedge winning, or a fence). error over 0.1/s: [VlpdsSegmentPutErrors](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdssegmentputerrors). stall seals: segments sealed early because the oldest PUT stalled.

panels.title: SlateDB apply per segment / checkpoint per shard
panels.description: Checkpoints (applied marker + memtable flush) that stop running: [VlpdsCheckpointsStalled](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdscheckpointsstalled).

panels.title: Retention passes
panels.description: [VlpdsRetentionFailing](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsretentionfailing), [VlpdsRetentionNotRunning](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsretentionnotrunning)

panels.title: Dead logs and replay hold
panels.description: unfenced for 30 min: [VlpdsDeadLogUnfenced](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsdeadlogunfenced); a growing replay hold: [VlpdsReplayBacklogHigh](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsreplaybackloghigh).

panels.title: Events emitted / frames sent per s
panels.description: Commits flowing but no events = [VlpdsFirehoseStalled](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsfirehosestalled) (page).

panels.title: Emit delay (seq assigned → emitted)
panels.description: Dashed: [VlpdsFirehoseEmitDelayHigh](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsfirehoseemitdelayhigh) and [VlpdsFirehoseEmitDelayCritical](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsfirehoseemitdelaycritical).

targets.expr: (sum by (instance) (vlpds_firehose_subscribers{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"})) * on (instance) group_left (node_id) max by (instance, node_id) (vlpds_build_info{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Disconnects and refusals
panels.description: too_slow = past --firehose-max-lag-mb ([VlpdsFirehoseConsumersTooSlow](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsfirehoseconsumerstooslow)); write_stalled = took no bytes for 30 s; refused per_ip = over --firehose-max-per-ip (429).

panels.title: Cursor backfills
panels.description: running / waiting for a slot (--firehose-max-backfills, default 16). Waiting for long = raise the cap or the readahead is too slow.

panels.title: Merger queue vs budget, rings
panels.description: Past the budget a log spills to S3 read-back. Over 80% for 10 min: [VlpdsFirehoseMergeQueueNearBudget](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsfirehosemergequeuenearbudget).

panels.title: Spills, lagged peer streams
panels.description: [VlpdsFirehoseMergeSpilling](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsfirehosemergespilling), [VlpdsPeerLogStreamLagging](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdspeerlogstreamlagging)

panels.title: getRepo exports
panels.description: streaming / waiting for a slot (--max-exports, default 32). shed = no slot within 10 s (503); stalled = the client read nothing for --export-stall-secs.

panels.title: Repo lookups by result
panels.description: hit: cached; miss: starts a cold load; loading: joins a load in flight.

panels.title: Repo cache hit ratio by node
panels.description: Mostly misses under steady load: [VlpdsRepoCacheMissRateHigh](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsrepocachemissratehigh) (cache too small for the active set).

targets.expr: (sum by (instance) (rate(vlpds_repo_cache_lookups_total{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", result="hit"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (instance) (rate(vlpds_repo_cache_lookups_total{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (instance) group_left (node_id) max by (instance, node_id) (vlpds_build_info{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Cold loads by result, evictions
panels.description: stale = a load finished after its shard moved (dropped, reloaded). error: [VlpdsRepoLoadErrors](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsrepoloaderrors).

panels.title: Repo cache: share of byte budget, repos held
panels.description: Loaded MST paths per node over --repo-cache-mb. Near 100%, idle repos drop back to their roots, then the least recently used are evicted.

targets.expr: (sum by (instance) (vlpds_repo_cache_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"}) / max by (instance) (vlpds_repo_cache_capacity_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"} > 0)) * on (instance) group_left (node_id) max by (instance, node_id) (vlpds_build_info{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Memory plan (busiest node)
panels.description: The node's memory budget (its limit, or --memory-budget-mb) as fixed costs plus the pool for the SST metadata, SST block and repo caches (src/memory.rs). `vlpds --memory-plan` prints it.

panels.title: Pool caches: target, capacity, used
panels.description: meta target: the owned SSTs' decoded filters + indexes (vlpds_sst_meta_need_bytes) x N/(N-1) x 1.25; the block and repo caches split the rest of the pool. Grows at once, shrinks after 5 min. A shortfall (the pool can't fit the target) is logged and feeds [VlpdsSstMetaCacheTooSmall](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdssstmetacachetoosmall).

panels.title: Lazy MST
panels.description: fallback invalid = a persisted MST didn't match its root ([VlpdsLazyMstInvalid](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdslazymstinvalid)).

panels.title: In-memory caches: fill
panels.description: Entries / entry cap per cache (busiest node). Pinned at 100% for hours: [VlpdsCacheAtCapacity](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdscacheatcapacity).

panels.title: 5xx/s by method
panels.description: Which methods fail. _proxy_or_unmatched = proxied to the AppView (its errors) or unknown paths.

panels.title: Connections
panels.description: Outbound connects should stay flat under steady load (pooled h2 over mTLS to peers).

panels.title: Proxied requests/s by status
panels.description: app.bsky / chat.bsky / tools.ozone and unmatched paths, proxied to the AppView or service.

panels.title: Proxy upstream: pool waits, read-after-write
panels.description: pool waits: proxied requests that waited for an upstream connection at the per-host cap. RAW: reads with an AppView rev and how our newer records were merged in.

panels.title: Auth and abuse: rate limits, shedding, caps
Rate-limit rejections by limiter
panels.description: Requests over a rate-limit bucket (429). One limiter dominating = one class of client; see the route panel.

panels.title: Rate-limit config version
panels.description: min != max = nodes on different configs; a rejected config keeps the last good one in force. 0 = flag defaults.

panels.title: Password hashing shed (Argon2)
panels.description: createSession / createAccount / OAuth sign-in answered 503 because every Argon2 permit stayed busy 2 s. Dashed: [VlpdsPasswordHashingShed](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdspasswordhashingshed) (0.5/s for 10 min): credential stuffing or a login storm.

targets.expr: ((sum by (instance) (rate(vlpds_argon2_shed_total{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (instance) group_left (node_id) max by (instance, node_id) (vlpds_build_info{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"})) > 0

panels.title: Proxy refusals
panels.description: Proxied requests refused before forwarding; account_cap = 429 at 64 in flight for one account. Dashed: [VlpdsProxyAccountCapSustained](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsproxyaccountcapsustained) (1/s for 30 min).

panels.title: Stalled bodies, accept errors, firehose per-IP
panels.description: Stalled bodies: proxied/forwarded responses the client stopped reading for 30 s (slowloris-style). Accept errors: usually out of file descriptors (retried every 50 ms). [Serving limits](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#tools-endpoints-cli-logs-exit-codes)

panels.title: Accounts: scheduled deletion, sign-in security, OAuth scopes
Scheduled-deletion sweeps
panels.description: Every node sweeps its own shards' D/ rows every 10 min. error = a shard scan or an account's deletion failed (retried next sweep). [VlpdsScheduledDeletionFailing](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsscheduleddeletionfailing)

panels.title: Scheduled-deletion accounts
panels.description: Per sweep outcome: deleted, finished (a deletion that stopped partway), raced (reactivated first; kept), failed. States as of each node's last sweep: scheduled (D/ rows), held (taken down or suspended), deferred (over the 100 per-pass cap: next sweep). A jump in scheduled: [VlpdsScheduledDeletionsSurge](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsscheduleddeletionssurge)

panels.title: Sign-in factors and alerts
panels.description: Successful sign-ins by method and second factor (trusted = a trusted browser skipped it), and new-device sign-ins by what became of their alert mail. budget: [VlpdsSignInAlertsSuppressed](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdssigninalertssuppressed)

panels.title: Sign-in refusals and settings
panels.description: createSession refused by the account (taken down, OAuth-only, app passwords off, passkey_required: a passkey is its only strong factor), and owners changing those settings.

panels.title: Passkeys
panels.description: Passkeys registered, removed and reset by the operator; registrations and assertions refused by the check that failed (origin / rp_id from another site, challenge = expired or another flow's, replay = a challenge used twice, unknown_credential = not one of the account's); signature counters that went backwards (refused = a hardware key, now flagged; accepted = a synced passkey); passwordless sign-ins by result. [A passkey flagged as copied](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#a-passkey-flagged-as-copied)

panels.title: Scope rejections (ScopeMissingError)
panels.description: 403s for a scope the OAuth token or scoped app password lacks, by the missing scope's kind. A steady rate from one kind is usually one client asking for less than it uses; the access log's route and client tell which.

panels.title: OAuth consents, handle checks
panels.description: Consent page answers (narrowed = some scopes unticked; refused = a forged post without atproto), and vlpds.identity.checkHandle answers with its per-DID rate-limit rejections.

panels.title: Spaces (--spaces): writes, notify outbox and fan-out, sync reads, credentials
Space writes by method and result
panels.description: createRecord / putRecord / deleteRecord / applyWrites into space repos. refused = a 4xx (validation, scope, an inactive account); error = a 5xx.

panels.title: Write → notify ack
panels.description: A space write's ack to its authority's 200 for the notifyWrite. Writes into the author's own space carry the authority's rows in the write's entry, so they send nothing and aren't counted here.

panels.title: notifyWrite outbox rows by node
panels.description: One row per (repo, space) this node still owes its authority a notify for. Writes made while a send is in flight only move their row's rev, so the count follows the active (repo, space) pairs, not the write rate.

targets.expr: (sum by (instance) (vlpds_space_outbox_rows{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"})) * on (instance) group_left (node_id) max by (instance, node_id) (vlpds_build_info{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: notifyWrite outbox oldest row
panels.description: Age of each node's oldest undelivered row. Retries back off from 1 min to 1 h and give up 24 h after the write. Dashed: [VlpdsSpaceOutboxBacklog](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsspaceoutboxbacklog) (1 h).

targets.expr: (max by (instance) (vlpds_space_outbox_oldest_seconds{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"})) * on (instance) group_left (node_id) max by (instance, node_id) (vlpds_build_info{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: notifyWrite by hop and result
panels.description: out = this node's writes to their authorities; in = notifies received as an authority; fanout = forwarded to registered syncers. ok = 200; retry = backing off; wait = the writer's account is inactive; refused / gone / expired = the row was dropped. in same_rev_unverified / same_rev_capped = a remote writer's same-rev, new-data notify (a record takedown) its host didn't confirm, or over 3 per writer and space in 10 min: dropped, left to polls.

panels.title: notifyWrite failure ratio by hop
panels.description: Dashed: [VlpdsSpaceNotifyFanoutFailing](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsspacenotifyfanoutfailing) (fanout over 50%). A dead syncer or a remote authority that's down shows up here first.

targets.expr: sum by (hop) (rate(vlpds_space_notify_total{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", result!="ok"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (hop) (rate(vlpds_space_notify_total{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: listRepoOps: at-head polls vs scans
panels.description: noop = since was the head, answered from the in-memory head with no state read (most syncer polls). scan = an oplog range scan.

panels.title: listRepoOps server time
panels.description: Handler time after auth, the commit's MAC (a KEM decapsulation and an HMAC) included. Targets: noop well under 1 ms, a typical delta a few ms.

panels.title: Space reads by method and auth
panels.description: credential = an Atproto-Space credential (another member or a syncer). oauth = the account reading its own repo.

panels.title: Credential cache hit ratio
panels.description: A hit costs a hash lookup and the request's P-256 signature check. A miss verifies the whole chain and resolves the authority's key. Low under steady polling means credentials churn faster than they expire, or the cache is too small.

panels.title: Credential checks by result
panels.description: ok, or why a credential read was refused (bad_sig, expired, revoked, audience, space). [VlpdsSpaceCredentialRejectsHigh](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsspacecredentialrejectshigh)

panels.title: Credentials and delegations issued
panels.description: getSpaceCredential answers as an authority (bad_token = the delegation token didn't verify), and delegation tokens minted for this node's accounts.

panels.title: Fan-out queue depth and drops
panels.description: Notifies waiting for a syncer, and the ones dropped (a newer one for the same syncer superseded it, or a host's queue was full). Superseded drops are normal. The syncer pulls from its last rev either way.

panels.title: Revocations held, blocks, digest mismatches
panels.description: Revoked credential ids still in force (kept until their credential could have expired). Blocks: spaces and authorities refused because a revocation of theirs couldn't be stored; saturated: every remote authority refused ([VlpdsSpaceRevocationsSaturated](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsspacerevocationssaturated)). Mismatches: [VlpdsSpaceDigestMismatch](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsspacedigestmismatch).

panels.title: Lease renewal round trip by node (p99)
panels.description: One CAS PUT of nodes/{node_id} every renew interval (TTL/5 by default). Round trips over (TTL - skew) / 2 (4 s at the default 10 s TTL, 54 s at 120 s with a 12 s skew) lapse the lease and the node fail-stops (exit 5); so does one stall past TTL - skew - renew. p99 over 500 ms for 10 min: [VlpdsLeaseRenewalSlow](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsleaserenewalslow).

targets.expr: (histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, instance) (rate(vlpds_lease_renew_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))) * on (instance) group_left (node_id) max by (instance, node_id) (vlpds_build_info{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Lease validity left by node
panels.description: Seconds until each node's lease validity ends, at scrape: a sawtooth between TTL - skew - one renew interval and TTL - skew. Dips toward 0 = renewals overdue; below the dashed line: [VlpdsLeaseValidityLow](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsleasevaliditylow).

panels.title: Renew errors, takeovers
panels.description: renew conflict/lapsed = fail-stop; timeout/error retry ([VlpdsLeaseRenewErrors](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsleaserenewerrors)). takeover peer: a dead peer's log fenced before taking its shards; restart: our own previous incarnation's at startup ([VlpdsUncleanNodeExit](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsuncleannodeexit)).

panels.title: Lease events/s
panels.description: opened/closed: shard moves (many per hour: [VlpdsOwnershipFlapping](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsownershipflapping)); peer_refused: a peer presumed dead ([VlpdsPeerPresumedDead](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdspeerpresumeddead)); history_full: a shard not taken because its history is at its span cap with no clean open (investigate: its log can't be trimmed); lost / shutdown_fence_failed: fail-stop paths.

panels.title: Shard opens (time to serve, p99)
panels.description: replay: the batch replayed a dead owner's log tail (takeover after a crash; over 20 s: [VlpdsTakeoverReplaySlow](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdstakeoverreplayslow)); clean: nothing to replay (handback).

panels.title: Shards opened / segments replayed per s
panels.description: opened error: [VlpdsShardOpenErrors](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsshardopenerrors).

panels.title: Exit state and versions
panels.description: Per node: how its previous process ended and when, the cluster feature level it last read and the max this build runs (binary max > active everywhere = a finalize is available: [VlpdsFeatureLevelUnfinalized](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsfeaturelevelunfinalized)), shard layout version.

panels.title: Integrity: format errors, signature faults
panels.description: Should be empty. Format errors: a newer-level node writing early, or corruption ([VlpdsFormatErrors](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsformaterrors), page). Signature faults: suspect hardware ([VlpdsSignatureFault](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdssignaturefault), page).

panels.title: Peer TLS: days until certificate expiry
panels.description: Per node, its own server certificate (cert=node) and the CA it trusts (cert=ca), as days until notAfter. Only nodes running peer TLS export it. An expired node cert is refused by every peer and the node won't start or reload with one. Dashed: 14 days = [VlpdsPeerTlsCertExpiring](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdspeertlscertexpiring) (ticket); 3 days = out of time, renew now (renewal procedure in the same section).

targets.expr: ((vlpds_peer_tls_cert_expiry_seconds{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"} - time()) / 86400) * on (instance) group_left (node_id) max by (instance, node_id) (vlpds_build_info{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Peer TLS: handshake failures/s by side
panels.description: Peer connections refused at the TLS handshake: server = a peer was refused by this node, client = this node was refused by (or refused) a peer. Cause: a cert from another CA, an expired cert, or an address whose lease names another node. Over 0.1/s for 10 min: [VlpdsPeerTlsHandshakeFailures](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdspeertlshandshakefailures).

panels.title: Peer TLS: certificate reloads by result
panels.description: Reloads of the CA/cert/key set (file change or SIGHUP). error = the new set failed to load and the node keeps the previous one, which the rotation meant to replace: [VlpdsPeerTlsReloadFailing](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdspeertlsreloadfailing).

panels.title: Forwards/s by owner status
panels.description: 5xx includes owner unreachable / past its TTFB deadline (503 PartitionUnavailable). Over 5%: [VlpdsForwardErrorsHigh](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsforwarderrorshigh).

panels.title: Forward latency (to the owner's response head)
panels.description: Deadline 3 s. Dashed: [VlpdsForwardLatencyHigh](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsforwardlatencyhigh) (p99 1 s).

targets.expr: (sum by (instance) (rate(vlpds_forwards_total{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (instance) group_left (node_id) max by (instance, node_id) (vlpds_build_info{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Control-plane latency
panels.description: Lease, assignment and fence reads/writes. Dashed: [VlpdsControlPlaneLatencyHigh](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdscontrolplanelatencyhigh) (p99 1 s).

panels.title: Control-plane timeouts, nudges, lone skips
panels.description: Timeouts: [VlpdsControlPlaneTimeouts](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdscontrolplanetimeouts).

panels.title: Retired-state GC
panels.description: [VlpdsReshardGcFailing](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsreshardgcfailing); retired dirs referenced > 0: [VlpdsRetiredStateReferenced](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsretiredstatereferenced).

panels.title: Forced compactions, inherited SSTs
panels.description: [VlpdsForcedDetachFailing](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsforceddetachfailing)

panels.title: Object store (vlpds clients, per pool and lane)
Permits in use / limit
panels.description: Busiest node's in-flight requests per pool (log, state, ctl) and lane (main; reserved = log writes / ctl lease writes) over its permits (--store-inflight, --log-store-inflight). At 100% requests queue: [VlpdsObjectStorePermitsSaturated](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsobjectstorepermitssaturated).

panels.title: Permit waits/s
panels.description: Dashed: [VlpdsObjectStorePermitsSaturated](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsobjectstorepermitssaturated) (1/s per pool and lane for 10 min).

panels.title: Requests/s by op
panels.description: Billable ops (put, put_cas, get, get_range, head, list pages, delete, ...): cost tracks this mix.

panels.title: Non-ok results/s
panels.description: not_found / precondition are normal answers (misses, lost CAS races); timeout / error failed; cancelled = the caller gave up.

panels.title: Throttled answers/s (429, 503 SlowDown)
panels.description: Every 429 or 503 SlowDown the store answered, retries included (object_store retries them inside its client, so the request counters see only the final result). lease = node leases, assignments, writer claims and the cluster version (LISTs by prefix; bulk deletes count as other). R2 takes about one write a second per key, and node lease writes retry 1-4 s apart. [VlpdsObjectStoreThrottled](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsobjectstorethrottled).

panels.title: p99 latency by component
panels.description: To the response head (GET), first page (LIST); deletes are not timed. [VlpdsObjectStoreLatencyHigh](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsobjectstorelatencyhigh)

panels.title: SlateDB (summed over each node's shard DBs)
Block cache hit rate by entry kind

targets.expr: sum by (entry_kind) (rate(slatedb_db_cache_access_count_total{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", result="hit"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (entry_kind) (rate(slatedb_db_cache_access_count_total{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Flushes, backpressure, stalls
panels.description: L0 stalls block writes: [VlpdsSlateDbL0Stalls](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsslatedbl0stalls).

panels.title: Object store requests/s and errors (SlateDB)
panels.description: SlateDB's own view of its store calls. Its error count includes normal answers (GETs of objects that don't exist yet, e.g. compactor polls; lost CAS races), so a steady rate here is not trouble by itself: real failures are result=error|timeout in the Object store row, where [VlpdsObjectStoreErrors](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsobjectstoreerrors) counts them for the state_* components (no alert reads this counter).

panels.title: CPU by mode
panels.description: CPU cores, summed over the selected nodes.

panels.title: RSS by node
panels.description: Resident set size. As a share of the node's memory limit: Health → Memory used / limit.

targets.expr: (max by (instance) (vlpds_process_resident_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"})) * on (instance) group_left (node_id) max by (instance, node_id) (vlpds_build_info{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: jemalloc
panels.description: allocated = live heap; resident - allocated = fragmentation and retained pages.

panels.title: Tokio worker utilization by node
panels.description: Busy / workers. Dashed: [VlpdsRuntimeSaturated](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsruntimesaturated) (90% for 15 min).

targets.expr: (sum by (instance) (rate(vlpds_tokio_busy_seconds_total{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (instance) (vlpds_tokio_workers{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"})) * on (instance) group_left (node_id) max by (instance, node_id) (vlpds_build_info{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Runtime lateness by node
panels.description: Share of time a 10 ms ticker woke late: ready tasks waited for a worker (blocking code on the runtime, or CPU starvation). Dashed: [VlpdsRuntimeStalls](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsruntimestalls) (5%).

targets.expr: (sum by (instance) (rate(vlpds_runtime_late_seconds_total{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (instance) group_left (node_id) max by (instance, node_id) (vlpds_build_info{cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: KMS requests/s by result
panels.description: unavailable: [VlpdsKeyServiceUnavailable](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdskeyserviceunavailable) (page: cold writes fail); unwrap rejected: [VlpdsSecretUnwrapRejected](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdssecretunwraprejected).

panels.title: PLC directory requests/s
panels.description: Write ops unavailable: [VlpdsPlcDirectoryUnavailable](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsplcdirectoryunavailable) (page); rejected: [VlpdsPlcOpsRejected](https://github.com/jazware/vlpds/blob/main/ops/RUNBOOK.md#vlpdsplcopsrejected).

defaults.noValue: no mail (SMTP not configured, or nothing sent)

panels.title: CPU flamegraph (dashboard time range, selected nodes)
panels.description: Needs a Pyroscope datasource (the Pyroscope picker at the top) and nodes started with --pyroscope-url.
